reason: Provides model-callable run_python and run_node tools that execute supplied code through local interpreters and expose execution results, with configurable interpreter paths and timeout settings.

summaries.zh: 通过可配置的 Python 和 Node.js 解释器执行代码，并向模型返回标准输出、标准错误和退出码。
summaries.en: Executes code through configurable Python and Node.js interpreters and returns the resulting stdout, stderr, and exit code.

capabilities: Executes Python code through a configured Python interpreter
Executes Node.js code through a configured Node.js interpreter
Spawns local interpreter processes and returns stdout, stderr, and exit code
Persists configurable interpreter paths and execution timeout settings
